```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Load data
memi <- read_csv("data/memi.csv")
fmli <- read_csv("data/fmli.csv")

# Wrangling
fmli <- mutate(fmli, PRINEARN = as.integer(PRINEARN)) %>%
  left_join(memi, join_by("NEWID" == "NEWID", "PRINEARN" == "MEMBNO"))
```
